# Shutap

> Shutap is a pseudonymous community where people vent about relationships, marriage, family, and work — and share what actually happened next.

Shutap is the alternative to anonymous-feed venting (Reddit, AITA, Quora). Members keep a consistent pseudonym across stories so voices have a track record, and outcomes are confirmed by the original author rather than inferred from sentiment.

The brand wordplay is "Shutap → speak up." The app is not a clinical service; the in-app companion never poses as a therapist or lawyer.

## Core

- [About](/about): What Shutap is, who it's for, and how it differs from anonymous feed venting.
- [Methodology](/methodology): How stories are written (real people, no AI-written stories), how outcomes are confirmed, how sensitive topics are routed.
- [Trust & privacy](/trust): Pseudonymity model, what is and isn't indexed, takedown path.

## Pillars

- [Relationships](/relationships): Dating, partners, situationships, breakups, the gray area in between.
- [Marriage](/marriage): The long-haul stuff — roommate energy, resentment, repair, leaving, staying.
- [Family](/family): Parents, siblings, in-laws, the family group chat, the guilt.
- [Career](/career): Work, money, bosses, burnout, the job everyone tells you to be grateful for.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of indexable pages.
